newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-SCHOLL OUT OF GERMAN LINE-UP AGAINST NORTHERN IRELAND.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SCHOLL OUT OF GERMAN LINE-UP AGAINST NORTHERN IRELAND.

text.p: Mehmet Scholl will not be able to play in Germany's World Cup qualifier against Northern Ireland in Nuremberg on Saturday because of an injured ankle, trainer Berti Vogts said on Friday.
Scholl, an attacking midfielder from Bayern Munich, took part in a training session on Friday but had to leave the pitch after just two minutes.
"It is unfortunate because he had recently played superbly in midfield against Armenia," Vogts said. "We will have to find someone else now."
Dortmund's Andreas Moeller will replace Scholl in the starting line-up. Moeller was injured and did not play in Germany's 5-1 win over Armenia last month.
Dieter Eilts, a defender, is also unlikely to play because of a knee injury.
